notes.title: Simulacro in the Made in Brazil Sale 🌀
notes.notes:
Hello, friends!

We have good news! From today until [b]March 4th[/b], Simulacro is part of the [b]Made in Brazil Sale[/b]! An event showcasing incredible Brazilian games.

[b]What awaits you in Simulacro?
[/b]
👁 An immersive first-person experience
⏳ 2 to 3 hours of thought-provoking gameplay
📖 A narrative inspired by the teachings of Plato, Aristotle, and Pythagoras
🧠 Dynamic puzzles seamlessly woven into the story
🗣 Fully narrated in Brazilian Portuguese

See you soon!

notes.title: Simulacro Demo Update! v0.19
notes.notes:
Thank you for downloading the demo, we've had a lot of downloads, and we hope you enjoyed it!

If you have any problems during the game, don't hesitate to contact us via the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2615750/discussions/]game forum[/url]. 

Cheers,
